problem:
Given the function  $y=4ln⁡x-\frac{1}{3}\cdot {2}^{x}+5$, find the instantaneous rate of change at $x=2.$ Do not round the answer.

The instantaneous rate of change at $x=2$ is
{{field-1}}.

feedback.worked_solution:
Taking the derivative, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({11}^{x}-5ln⁡x) \\  & ={11}^{x}\cdot ln⁡11-5(\frac{1}{x}) \\  & ={11}^{x}ln⁡11-\frac{5}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$
